item.text: The initial spring is a valid single solid. I’m checking the coil spacing and end positions in the four-view preview. [Live CAD view](http://127.0.0.1:8771/#part.FCStd)
The preview is close in proportion. The reference appears to have slightly wider coil spacing and flat-ground ends; I’ll adjust those details and check the result.
The adjusted spring has five turns and flat-ground ends, with all four views close to the reference. It remains a valid single solid. I’ll export the STEP file now.
